description: This Java class defines an abstract test class for module testing within the OpenMRS project. It extends a base test class and specifies configuration files for the application context, deprecated as of version 2.4, and provides guidance on migrating from JUnit 4 to JUnit 5.

classes.name: BaseModuleContextSensitiveTest
